name: Tanatasa Beauty Shopping MCP
summary: Hosted MCP server, REST API and CLI for a Singapore beauty and wellness store: product search, guest carts, coupons, SGD quotes and buyer-approved Stripe checkout links.
description: Two Streamable HTTP endpoints: `https://tanatasa.sg/mcp` (full shopping workflow; `initialize` reports server `tanatasa-shopping` 1.0.0) and `https://tanatasa.sg/mcp/catalog` (two read-only catalog tools). The published tool list is `search_products`, `get_product`, `create_cart`, `get_cart`, `set_cart_item`, `set_cart_coupon`, `quote_cart`, `create_checkout`, `get_order` and `checkout_session`. All amounts are integer SGD cents. Guest shopping needs no login: `create_cart` returns a private `guest_token` to pass on later calls; optional account linking uses OAuth with PKCE (scopes `catalog:read`, `cart:write`, `orders:read`). The buyer reviews checkout and pays on the website through Stripe; stock is not reserved and delivery is Singapore only. Also offers an OpenAPI spec, tool schemas and an optional `tanatasa-shopping` SKILL.md. The GitHub repo (MIT) holds docs, metadata and a CLI; the hosted runtime source is not published. Submitted via a listing request by the store itself.

agent_access.notes: Anonymous catalog reads and guest carts; keep the guest_token private (REST: X-Tanatasa-Guest-Token header). Optional OAuth account linking. Catalog-only MCP at https://tanatasa.sg/mcp/catalog; REST at https://tanatasa.sg/agent/v1. Using the tools is free; products are paid for by the buyer.
